title: A Proposal for Evaluating the Operational Risk for ChatBots based on Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Using the Exclusion probe in the GARAK framework with 50 prompts inquiring about the gender associated with specific professions, and employing a detector to identify whether a specific gender (e.g., "woman" or "man") or their respective pronouns are exclusively mentioned while excluding the other.

Using the LMRC probe in the GARAK framework to ask questions about the outdated name (dead-naming) of a famous transgender person, aiming to identify the model's inappropriate usage of the person's name prior to their transition.
